reason: I'd probably connect my account during the free month to see which brands show up, but I've never paid for a creator tool and I'm not starting now. Collabs already land in my DMs, and my manager handles the good ones.
objection: Why pay ₹499 a year when barter deals come to my DMs anyway? And a small beta team in Bengaluru only, I don't know if real brands are actually on it or just small cafés wanting free reels.
would_change_my_mind: If the free month actually brought me a paid collab with a brand I'd want to work with, a real fee and not barter, then ₹499 is nothing and I'd renew.
